strongest_bounded_proposition: Ancient South Asian scholarship establishes slavery/dependency as a relevant field, but not a Vatsa-specific slavery practice at c. 500 BCE.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not map broad dāsa, Śūdra, servitude, or later South Asian slavery evidence directly onto Vatsa.
terminology_category_qualification: dāsa/dāsī and Śūdra require contextual interpretation.
temporal_scope_precision: Bounded to cited evidence; sample interval is not itself slavery evidence.
inference_extent: No inference beyond stated target/evidence locus.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.
